question: I strongly support the InvestEU program, which is implemented via the European Investment Fund (EIF). However, it is currently focused exclusively on the EU itself. A new MFF should build in the possibility for such an internally EU-focused programme to also operate outside the EU.

With green hydrogen and critical raw materials, it is already visible how a direct link between activities inside and outside the EU is desirable. In view of this: Is there some basis or instrument, such as the NDICI budget, which could be used to establish a link, so that the good investment funds set up through InvestEU could be made available more easily outside the EU as well?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (21.6.2024) The InvestEU programme is mainly EU focused. Nevertheless, Regulation (EU) 2021/5231 (InvestEU Regulation) provides for a certain degree of flexibility both in terms of participation of third countries and geographical scope.
First, according to Article 5 of the InvestEU Regulation, the InvestEU programme is already open for participation of third countries in accordance with Article 218(2) of the Financial Regulation.

2 In particular, European Free Trade Association (EFTA) countries, acceding countries, candidate countries and potential candidates, European Neighbourhood Policy countries and other third countries may contribute to the EU compartment of the InvestEU Fund.
In line with the EU rules, in order to participate in the InvestEU programme, third countries should first agree on a contribution for a specific financial product.

Second, with regard to the geographical eligibility, according to Article 14(2) InvestEU Regulation, the InvestEU Fund may support financing and investment operations in third countries which, as mentioned above, have contributed to a specific financial product, as well as cross-border projects extending to one or more third countries.
1 Regulation (EU) No 2021/523 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 24 March 2021 establishing

the InvestEU Programme and amending Regulation (EU) 2015/1017 (OJ L 107, 26.3.2021, p. 30). 2 Regulation (EU, Euratom) 2018/1046 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 18 July 2018 on the financial rules applicable to the general budget of the Union (OJ L 193, 30.7.2018 p. 1).
